base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq cmake build-essential ninja-build pkg-config wget ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release python3-full python3-venv git curl
activation_command: source /opt/benchmark/dali_venv/bin/activate && export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda && export PATH=$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: Use pytest from venv; DALI tests require built DALI binaries
runtime_profile.notes: CUDA toolkit should be provided by base image (nvidia/cuda:12.0.1-devel-ubuntu22.04). DALI build requires CMake 3.18+ and CUDA toolkit. Tests use Google Test framework (C++) and pytest (Python).

notes: NVIDIA DALI is a GPU-accelerated data loading library. The base image should include CUDA toolkit. This environment provides CMake 3.25+, Python 3.11 venv with pytest and numpy. The actual DALI build requires CUDA toolkit which should come from the nvidia/cuda base image. git and curl are included in system packages as they are available in the base Debian image.
